title: 高市首相、ベトナム・豪州歴訪へ出発　「具体的協力を発信したい」
extracted_text: 高市早苗首相は1日、ベトナムとオーストラリアを訪問するため政府専用機で羽田空港を出発した。2日にベトナムの最高指導者、トー・ラム共産党書記長（国家主席）ら、4日に豪州のアルバニージー首相との首脳会談に臨む予定だ。5日に帰国する。 首相は出発に先立ち、首相公邸で記者団の取材に応じ、「厳しい国際環境も踏まえながら、各国の自律性、強じん性を確保していくための具体的協力を発信したい」と語った。 ベトナムについては「医療物資を含む日本のサプライチェーン（供給網）の重要拠点」と指摘。首脳会談では「経済安全保障分野を新たな協力の軸として打ち出したい」と強調した。日本の外交方針「自由で開かれたインド太平洋」の新構想について演説する考えも示した。 「準同盟国」と位置づける豪州との首脳会談では、安全保障に加え、重要鉱物やエネルギーを含む経済安全保障など幅広い分野での協力について議論し、「日豪関係を新たな高みに引き上げていきたい」と意欲を示した。 また、緊迫する中東情勢を踏まえ、「アジア域内のエネルギー安定供給や重要鉱物などを含むサプライチェーン強じん化についても協力を確認したい」と語った。【野間口陽、原諒馬】
translated_text: Prime Minister Sanae Takai departed on a government aircraft from Haneda Airport on the 1st to visit Vietnam and Australia. She is scheduled to hold summit talks on the 2nd with Vietnam's top leader, General Secretary To Lam of the Communist Party who also serves as State President, and on the 4th with Australian Prime Minister Albanese. She is due to return to Japan on the 5th. Prior to her departure, the Prime Minister spoke to reporters at the official residence, saying, "Amid the severe international environment, I want to convey concrete cooperation to ensure the autonomy and resilience of each nation." Regarding Vietnam, she noted it as "an important hub in Japan's supply chain, including medical supplies." She emphasized that during the summit talks, she wants to "position economic security as a new axis of cooperation." She also expressed her intention to give a speech on the new concept of Japan's foreign policy, the "Free and Open Indo-Pacific." In summit talks with Australia, described as a "quasi-ally," she expressed eagerness to discuss cooperation across a wide range of areas, including security as well as economic security covering critical minerals and energy, saying, "I want to elevate Japan-Australia relations to a new height." Additionally, in light of the tense situation in the Middle East, she said, "I want to confirm cooperation on strengthening supply chains, including stable energy supply within the Asian region and critical minerals." [By Yosaku Nomaguchi and Ryoma Hara]
title_en: Prime Minister Takai departs for Vietnam, Australia tour — "Want to convey concrete cooperation"
